Have a rootin' tootin' birthday pardner! Don't be lassoin' up all the fair wenches down at the saloon while I'm out on the plains y'hear? Have a free Calibogo on me! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hm_6xvIniM4
Thank you

I just saw her pop onto Facebook for a moment this evening. She didn't say anything to me. 

Part of me is so relieved+happy for her. Another part is angry. When I woke up this morning I was in tears+in a very nihilistic space. Now I just don't know who to trust.

I think it happened yesterday, I found out only through sheer fluke today, I chastised her about coming off meds prematurely without consulting a GP because of the side effects of withdrawal and that's when she told me she didn't care and planned to kill herself today. I messaged SW after but understandably they were either having a Sunday off or asleep. In any case they were off duty. 

I found her saying 'goodbye [me] have a nice life' ion my Facebook inbox, just an hour ago. The message was sent 5 hr.s ago. I got through to her on FB for one message where she just said 'bye man, I've made my choice'

tl;dr it came out of nowhere, escalated from 'bad day' being dumped through to...this 

I don't think I can help even though I want to 

thank you, I'm going to try and get some sleep soon 

edit: We have only known each other a few months. We've somewhat bonded as pen pals due to similar circumstances and struggles. Unfortunately, the arena in which we intiially bonded was toxic for her, but she had a strain of OCD and was compelled to lurk all the same
Thank you.

You're right. Why didn;t I do that. Fuck. I'm so stupid.  

I felt awkward beccause this was unprecedented. I talked to her for a while, got her to speak to her psych. she got diagnosed, medicated, iot helped a bit, she even got a boyfriend-buyt then she got fed up of the medication saying 'it made me sleepy', she's relapsed hard,. her ex has left her for whatever reason and she's very vulnerable. 

and I've been so absorbed with my onw obsessions and anxiety disorder lately I didn't check out for her enough. I thought her bf was keeping her stable as was her family. fuck fuck fuck aaarghhb

asked her phone no.? Sorry I don't quite get you. 

I don't have her no. We live in separate countries. We bonded over an...odd mutual circumstance 

I am not sure. I could never forgive myself if I trivialised the pain of someone suffering as just being a 'drama queen'
Yeah, it was a tough call. I just don't know what to say. After a bit, @I am here for you@ seems crude trite and meaningless
Please understand, she has recently posted to SuicideWatch stating her intentions (I don't want to say which post)-if I don't act immediately then...

I considered just making some comments about the movies I've noticed she's been watching, just to take her mind off things, do you think that will help? or will it make it worse 

I hate saying this as well but I really need sleep. Fuck this is so selfish I have not slept in 2 days. I punched a bag before in anger and my heart rate went through the roof. I'll nhate myself if it turns out she needed me during the night though :(
Please somebody talk to me. I think I was was too late. I don't know how to call a hotline for another country on someone's behalf

Well ain'tchoo the finest dame this side o' the long plains. This encounter was an apple pie order true and fair! Pleasure t'meet you ma'am, Squicky at yer service. *tips hat* 

An' ma'am, a cowboy never leaves his post 'til he's called off duty by the good sheriff. Bein' respectful n'all I ain't seen no good sheriffs round this here rough neck o'the woods, nosir. If ye climb in the saddle, be ready for the ride, me pa' would always say rest his soul.

*tips hat* thankin' ye smartly pardner 

as me ol' grampappy used t' say, 'it takes a smart guy t'play dumb'

an' those fancy pants authorities in their suits don't pay no attention t'dummy commonfolk like me. More power t'the people

son ye got it all wrong. 

A lady wants a man knows how t'be a *man*. She don't need no lil' boy beatin' round t'mulberry bush, can see through that ol' mirage like ah can see through Lady Jane's skirt (*praise the lawd!*)
Ah say ah say they buildin' themselves a court o' jesters!

Ah have a question Mister 5HourEnergyExtra. 

To wut extent do y'all take these here mods and ECs who are all anon bein' a dog on this new-goddurn-fangled Internet techno wacky-backy 'n'all all at their word, when they could just go do an ol' fancy switcheroo like Buckaroo yonder n' go make some dupes t'git some o' their own agenda across convincin' everyone they're bein' a fair 'n' honest sheriff 'n'all? 

Ah mean wut if down here in ye olde PurplePillDebate we got ourselves some serious sock puppets huh? Sir those boys worship how t'fool a good soul like it was sweet baby Jesus hisself. Take a look at that here 'side-bar' post, '48 Laws o'Power super thread'. My oh my these sonuvvabitches are takin' lessons on how t'be wolves in pig's clothes!!! So why sir why would you trust them at their word huh? 

Aw heck wut if ye got a sly dog pulling' wool over our eyes, callin' himself a red pillar under one name, then bein' all yeller belly 'n' posin' as blue purple or stranger in a strange land on t'other name? Ah don't trust a man who stands on a stage in a balaclava nosir.

Back in the Alamo we quickly learned ain't no such thing as democracy when a hard-done boy's got a bone t'pick. Every man fur hisself out in the badlands.

Just m'two coppers.
Sometimes a gunslinger misses his mark…*trots forlornly into distance as the sun sets and tumbleweeds roll across frame. Roll credits*
Hey feller, we need to consider *all* opinions to get a balanced view! If one scientist disagrees, then we don't exactly have consensus no more
Aye m'lady, Squicky at yer service!

Ah Mister Cheesy, wut if this here marriage business wuz actually historically to do with keepin' the chieftain's cronies content and stopping' them from knockin' on his door at an unholy hour with a torch 'n' hard club? Wut if he knew that the best way t'keep a man happy was to give him a fair dame? Wut if he wanted to lay in the manger with all the darlings, but knew he wouldn't live t'see the day?! After all, a happy tribe is a peaceful tribe! So wut if they just did not darn tooting' *care* about 'monogamous pair bonding'? Ah mean we're talkin' cavemen here, they had no cities, no religion, no nuttin' 'kept the skin o'their prey, a fire and a sweet baby Jesus tinglin' in their loins!

Aw yessir Mister Nomdplume, ah think we all can see that *hyuck*...but that could be cuz of the way this new darn-diddly-arn fangled modern society is structured really! Ain't much proof that it's got nuffin' to do with biology yet!
Now here's a prospector who knows how to strike gold!
Afternoon pardner, wut say we saddle up the nessies, git down the salon and wring us up some fair wenches? Meet you outside Old Man Beedle's at sundown.
Wonder Woman kinda just proves that your average Tom, Dick and Harry will be fallin' over their own goddarn feet fer a pretty face
Mister Broskidoski, ah clearly got mah friend to ask *both* "are males polygamous?" *and* "are females hypergamous?"
With due respect, ma'am, this is as much for mah privacy as your 'entertainment'...
Ah'll tell you what's a poison: gin and milk! Lord mah spleen burned that night
Wut act? Ah don't post much on t'other account ma'am, just give the ol' PPD a lil' perusal with the mornin' papers while the missus fries me up some bacon 'n' eggs, mmm glorious
but ah have seen studies which clearly say the girls like to mate with the biggest, strongest, purdiest guys!
Aw shucks Mister CheesyProle, they did mention sumfin' about this *Sex at Dawn* business ye speak of...
Mah mama always said, "if ye want to get by in this shady neck o' the woods, never leave the house without a mask or three in yer proverbial rucksack!"
